messages.author: fd98f08a6ab27905
messages.subject: Re: Shiny Manual 5.0
parts:
Ah, okay, I thought the actionButton was already included in 0.5.0 but it does not seem so.

Anyway, check page 3:

shiny-package
Web Application Framework for R
Description
Shiny makes it incredibly easy to build interactive web applications with R. Automatic "reactive"
binding between inputs and outputs and extensive pre-built widgets make it possible to build beau-
tiful, responsive, and powerful applications with minimal effort.
The Shiny tutorial at
http://rstudio.github.com/shiny/tutorial
explains the framework in-
depth, walks you through building a simple application, and includes extensive annotated examples.
Details
Package: shiny
Type: Package
Version: 0.1.0
Date: 2012-07-28
License: GPL-3
Depends: R (>= 2.14.1), methods, websockets (>= 1.1.4), caTools, RJSONIO, xtable
Imports: stats, tools, utils, datasets
URL: https://github.com/rstudio/shiny, http://rstudio.github.com/shiny/tutorial
BugReports: https://github.com/rstudio/shiny/issues




Best
